summary: Tested the new post-login routing (admin/boekhouder go to the kiosk in Beheer mode, superadmin goes to /admin), the SubscriptionBell in the kiosk header, kiosk logout and the /auth/admin-to-kiosk permission checks. Every requested flow passes. Admin demo@surirent.sr lands on /kiosk. The hamburger, settings gear, bell and Uitloggen are all visible. The bell dropdown's 'Naar Mijn abonnement' button opens the 'Mijn abonnement' popup inside the kiosk and the URL stays /kiosk. The Huurders, Betalingen and Facturen popups load data with no API errors. Boekhouder lands on /kiosk and sees 8 tiles (huurders, betalingen, regelingen, facturen, notificaties, borg, nfc, kasgeld). Boekhouder has no settings gear and no bell, and the Betalingen popup loads. Superadmin lands on /my-awesome-rentals-bv/admin, the admin environment, not the kiosk. Uitloggen clears localStorage and the auth cookies and lands on /<slug>/login?pick=1&loggedout=1. It does not bounce back to the kiosk, and visiting /login again does not auto-redirect. Kiosk employee email+password then PIN 5566 lands on /my-awesome-rentals-bv/kiosk with no Beheer menu, settings gear or bell. Injecting a personal-pin/login token via the API and opening /kiosk gives the same result.

minor.issue: The PIN-only pad on /my-awesome-rentals-bv/login?target=kiosk&view=pin (no email) rejects PIN 5566 with 401 'Ongeldige PIN code'. The PIN for kiosk.medewerker@surirent.sr is stored on the user document, so the employees query that kiosk-pin uses (kiosk_pin_hash) never finds it. POST /auth/personal-pin/login with email+pin returns 200, and the email+password→PIN flow works. Probably not caused by this change, but a user who taps the PIN alone on a fresh device cannot log in.

action_items: Optional: make /auth/kiosk-pin (PIN-only pad) also match user-level personal PINs, such as kiosk.medewerker's 5566, or show a hint to use 'Inloggen met e-mail'.

Optional hardening: enterKioskAfterLogin sends localStorage.active_company_id. If it is stale (for example left over from a superadmin session on the same device) a normal admin gets a 403 and silently falls back to /admin. Send company_id only for superadmin, or retry without company_id when the response is 403.
critical_code_review_comments: kioskEntry.js: on a 403 from a stale active_company_id the catch block silently falls back to goAdmin(). The user lands in /admin instead of the kiosk with no feedback.
The backend ownership check for admin-to-kiosk works: a non-superadmin asking for another company gets 403, an unknown company gets 404, and superadmin is allowed any company.
KioskLayout.jsx is far beyond 700 lines (5000+) and should be split into modules.
The popup testid is kiosk-popup-inst-abonnement-* (overlay/body), not an exact 'kiosk-popup-inst-abonnement'. Visually confirmed that it opens.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: demo@surirent.sr/demo1234, boekhouder@surirent.sr/test1234, super@surirent.sr/super1234, kiosk.medewerker@surirent.sr/test1234 with PIN 5566.
context_for_next_testing_agent: demo@surirent.sr and boekhouder belong to the SAME company (demo-company-fixed-uuid-00000000000, slug my-awesome-rentals-bv). For 403 tests, take another company id from GET /api/companies as superadmin. The Beheer tile testids are kiosk-admin-menu-<key>. Do not filter by has_text, because the overlay contains every tile's text. The popup testids are kiosk-popup-<key>-body. The 401s on /auth/me before login are expected.
